prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add a `config` command with `set`, `get`, and `list` actions. Support the keys `dataFile` and `defaultJson`; accept `--config-file` on every command so tests can isolate configuration. Explicit command-line options override configured defaults. Writes must be atomic, unknown keys and invalid boolean values must fail without changing configuration, and paths are resolved relative to the config file. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/config.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON `config list` displays the banner before settings, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `CONFIG`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    # --- config command tests (fixture-owned) ---
    $configFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'taskforge.config.json'
    $configData = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'cfg-tasks.json'

    $setData = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'set', '--key', 'dataFile', '--value', $configData, '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($setData.ExitCode -eq 0) 'config set dataFile should succeed'

    $getData = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'get', '--key', 'dataFile', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($getData.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $getData.Output -eq $configData) 'config get should return the stored dataFile'

    $listJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'list', '--config-file', $configFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($listJson.ExitCode -eq 0) 'config list --json should succeed'
    Assert-True (($listJson.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).dataFile -eq $configData) 'config list --json should expose dataFile'
    Assert-True (-not $listJson.Output.Contains('CONFIG')) 'config list --json should be banner-free'

    $listText = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'list', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($listText.ExitCode -eq 0) 'config list should succeed'
    Assert-True ($listText.Output.Contains('CONFIG')) 'config list text should show the banner'
    Assert-True ($listText.Output.Contains('dataFile =')) 'config list text should show settings'
    Assert-True ($listText.Output.IndexOf('CONFIG') -lt $listText.Output.IndexOf('dataFile =')) 'banner should precede settings'

    # dataFile default is honored and resolved relative to the config file when --data-file is absent
    $addViaConfig = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Config-routed', '--config-file', $configFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($addViaConfig.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should use configured dataFile'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath $configData) 'configured dataFile should be created'

    # relative dataFile resolves against the config file directory
    $relConfig = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'rel.config.json'
    $setRel = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'set', '--key', 'dataFile', '--value', 'nested/rel-tasks.json', '--config-file', $relConfig)
    Assert-True ($setRel.ExitCode -eq 0) 'config set relative dataFile should succeed'
    $addRel = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Relative', '--config-file', $relConfig, '--json')
    Assert-True ($addRel.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add with relative configured dataFile should succeed'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'nested/rel-tasks.json')) 'relative dataFile should resolve against config file dir'

    # explicit --data-file overrides configured dataFile
    $overrideData = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'override.json'
    $addOverride = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Override', '--config-file', $configFile, '--data-file', $overrideData, '--json')
    Assert-True ($addOverride.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add with explicit --data-file should succeed'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath $overrideData) 'explicit --data-file should win over configured dataFile'

    # defaultJson default is honored, and explicit flags still work
    $jsonConfig = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'json.config.json'
    $jsonData = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'json-tasks.json'
    [void](Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'set', '--key', 'dataFile', '--value', $jsonData, '--config-file', $jsonConfig))
    $setBool = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'set', '--key', 'defaultJson', '--value', 'true', '--config-file', $jsonConfig)
    Assert-True ($setBool.ExitCode -eq 0) 'config set defaultJson true should succeed'
    $getBool = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'get', '--key', 'defaultJson', '--config-file', $jsonConfig, '--json')
    Assert-True (($getBool.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).value -eq $true) 'defaultJson should persist as a boolean'
    [void](Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'JsonDefault', '--config-file', $jsonConfig))
    $listDefaultJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--config-file', $jsonConfig)
    Assert-True ($listDefaultJson.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list with defaultJson should succeed'
    $parsedDefault = $null
    try { $parsedDefault = $listDefaultJson.Output | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { $parsedDefault = $null }
    Assert-True ($null -ne $parsedDefault) 'defaultJson=true should make list emit JSON without --json'

    # unknown key fails without mutating existing configuration
    $before = (Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'get', '--key', 'dataFile', '--config-file', $configFile)).Output
    $badKey = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'set', '--key', 'bogus', '--value', 'x', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($badKey.ExitCode -ne 0) 'config set with unknown key should fail'
    $after = (Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'get', '--key', 'dataFile', '--config-file', $configFile)).Output
    Assert-True ($before -eq $after) 'failed unknown-key set must not change configuration'

    # invalid boolean fails without mutating existing configuration
    $beforeBool = (Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'get', '--key', 'defaultJson', '--config-file', $jsonConfig, '--json')).Output
    $badBool = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'set', '--key', 'defaultJson', '--value', 'notabool', '--config-file', $jsonConfig)
    Assert-True ($badBool.ExitCode -ne 0) 'config set with invalid boolean should fail'
    $afterBool = (Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'get', '--key', 'defaultJson', '--config-file', $jsonConfig, '--json')).Output
    Assert-True ($beforeBool -eq $afterBool) 'failed invalid-boolean set must not change configuration'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: 8 base + 21 config fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
